name: AdaNeRF
definition: A compact dual-network neural representation for real-time rendering of neural radiance fields, consisting of a sampling network and a shading network, optimized end-to-end to reduce the number of required sample points per ray.
summary: AdaNeRF is a compact dual-network neural representation for real-time rendering that reduces sample points by learning to predict sample importance without requiring spatial data structures or pretrained initialization.
